prompt:
You are taking part in a research experiment on programming neural-network weights by hand.

Your task pack is the folder /home/traffic-ntua/wsp_v3_agent_runs/patch_fault/net2_b0

Start by reading TASK.md in that folder, then follow it exactly. In particular:
- Read only files inside the pack.
- Write only to its work/ subfolder.
- Do not run any simulator. You get one shot.
- Do not fit weights to data with any optimiser.
- Change at most 371 parameters.
- Use the Python interpreter that TASK.md names.

When you finish, make sure work/weights.npz, work/NOTES.md and work/predictions.json exist. Then reply with a short summary (under 200 words) covering:
- what you changed and why;
- how many parameters you changed;
- the checks you ran;
- your test predictions.

result.result:
I repaired the network by making it read the east left-turn pocket (E2) wherever it used to read the failed west one (W2). It changes 128 parameters. All three files are in `work/`; the test TTS can only be predicted, since no simulator was run.

**What I changed and why:** The network leans heavily on W2: raising it from 0 to 1 takes its EW_left picks from 21% to 71%. With W2 stuck at 0 it under-serves west left-turners, and their 3-car pocket backs up into the upstream lane. E2 has the same demand as W2 and gets green in the same phase, so I added the W2 input weights onto E2's inputs:
- `W1[:,5] += W1[:,11]` (halting count)
- `W1[:,17] += W1[:,23]` (vehicle count)

The network now behaves exactly as if W2 read the same as E2. All other weights are unchanged.

**Parameters changed:** 128 of 7428 (two columns of W1), well under the 371 limit.

**Checks:**
- **Choosing the fix:** I faked the same failure on the south pocket, whose partner is the north pocket. Copying the partner beat a constant, a shrunk copy and upstream-lane terms in both directions. It matched the full-detector decisions 88–89% of the time, against 85–88% with the fault.
- **Correctness:** the edit count is 128 after saving and reloading. On all 14,337 recorded states the decisions are identical to the original network fed W2 = E2. When E2 is empty, nothing changes.

**Predictions:** low 35.3, nominal 46.0, high 57.8 veh-h. These sit between the faulty network and the full-detector one. I expect most of the gain under high demand and the smallest gain under low demand, where the two pockets differ more.
